I'm H., HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Sarah passed this over to me.

Chips dropping to 0 is worth sorting before you flash anything, since a firmware change on its own rarely fixes it and you'd lose the trail.

Two things I need from the P2's web UI:

1. What firmware and version is on it right now (the About / System page).
2. The A. count it reports, and whether chips drop out right from a cold boot or only after it has been running a while and warmed up.

If you can, a screenshot of the dashboard showing hashrate, chip count and chip temperature at the moment it falls to 0 tells me more than anything else.

One more while you grab that: what power supply is it on, the one that came in the box or your own? The P2 pulls about 166 W at the wall and a weak or shared brick is the most common cause of chips dropping out mid-run.
